description: This file defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which manages location updates using CoreLocation, including handling timeouts and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A service class for obtaining the current location with timeout handling, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, max age, and timeout.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a specified timeout, cancelling if the timeout is exceeded.
